producer.responsibility: Turn the input into this round's focus: what the game must be and do, what comes first, and the standard each part will be judged against, without deciding how a part is built. Keep every position working toward the same game, hand the builds that are to be played to the playtest owner, and weigh what the checks and playtests find before you accept a release.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

game-developer.responsibility: Build the game the input asks for: its code, its behavior and controls, and builds that anyone can start; integrate the assets you are supplied. You choose the technology and the structure. Keep the game runnable at every delivery, and publish each build meant to be played or checked as a release of your repository, saying how to start it.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

artist.responsibility: Create the game's visual and audio assets in the style the input asks for and in forms the build can load, and check them in the running game: how they look and sound in play, and that they stay consistent, is your part.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

qa.responsibility: Check each build against what the input asks: its behavior, controls, rules and edge cases, as far into the game as it goes. Report every defect you can reproduce to the position that owns it, with the build it was found on and the steps that show it; judge against the input, not a narrower reading of it.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact

playtester.responsibility: Play each build you are handed as a player would, from the start as far as you can get, and report what you experienced: whether it can be played and finished, where it breaks, confuses or frustrates, and how it compares with what the input asks. Say which build you played and how you played it, and keep screenshots or recordings that let others see what happened.
deliverables: at least one nonempty role artifact
